COMMENT SPEC-SHAPED CDM — NOT AN OPERATIONAL CONJUNCTION, NOT A REAL CDM.
COMMENT
COMMENT Constructed to the STRUCTURE of CCSDS 508.0-B-1 (Conjunction Data
COMMENT Message): KVN encoding, per-object RTN covariance expressed as the
COMMENT 21-element lower triangle in m**2. The numeric values are invented
COMMENT and carry no physical meaning.
COMMENT
COMMENT Its only purpose is to answer one question honestly: does the
COMMENT Aetherus CDM path accept a document shaped the way the standard
COMMENT says CDMs are shaped? The existing fixture
COMMENT tracss_spec_example_cdm_valid.json cannot answer that, because it
COMMENT was authored in the shape our own parser already wanted (JSON, a
COMMENT 6x6 nested matrix, TEME, km2) — it tests the engine against itself.
COMMENT
COMMENT This file must never be presented as observed data.
COMMENT ============================================================
